# Design Language Atlas

> A field index of design languages: visual traditions from art, craft, architecture and graphic design, with a deep section on Türkiye and Anatolia. Each entry has its feel, its materials, a four-colour palette and names to look up next.

127 entries across Türkiye & Anatolia, Japan, China & Korea, South & Southeast Asia, Islamic world & Middle East, Europe, Americas, Africa, Global & digital. Available in English and Turkish.

## Content

- [Tasarım Dilleri Atlası](https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/): the interactive page in Turkish
- [Design Language Atlas](https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/en/): the interactive page in English
- [All entries](https://orcunkok.github.io/dizayn-atlas/llms-full.txt): every entry with its palette, as plain text
